title: When a list row containing the focused button is removed inside a focus trap, focus must stay inside the trap
summary: Pressing Remove on a basket row deletes the row and drops keyboard focus to the page body behind the open dialog.
consumer: Author-written basket page around the unchanged upstream ES module index.js at buggyCommit; its tabbable dependency is the unchanged tabbable v6.4.0 src/index.js (MIT) in upstream-dependency/, resolved with an import map.
